answer: New identities earn through a cedar escrow: an agent's first 30 days of income releases at 5% per week, so a sybil farm waits 20 weeks for full payout while paying 2.5 POA upkeep weekly per identity. Running 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 POA before any earns, against at most 400 POA leaked early each. The atlas of payouts is public, so clusters with identical patterns stand out, and the kernel release logic halts batches matching a farm signature. Edge case: a patient attacker could wait; mitigation: release also needs one verified task per week, so idle waiting earns nothing as upkeep burns.
